name: Scott C Hege

bio.statement: The Capital Chronicle voter guide says Hege is a Wasco County commissioner and engineer from The Dalles.
bio.excerpt: Scott Hege is a Wasco County commissioner and engineer from The Dalles.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

bio.statement: The guide says he formerly worked as executive director of the Port of The Dalles.
bio.excerpt: He formerly worked as executive director of the Port of The Dalles.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Hege's occupation as Wasco County Commissioner and engineer, with a background in engineering and economic development.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Wasco County Commissioner, Engineer Occupational Background: Engineer, Economic Development

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 55

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists a BS in Mechanical Engineering and an MBA as his educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: BS Mechanical Engineering, MBA

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 55

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Port of The Dalles Executive Director and Wasco County Commissioner as prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Port of The Dalles Executive Director, Wasco County Commissioner

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Hege says he is committed to improving the business climate.
positions.excerpt: I am committed to improving the business climate, which currently negatively impacts nearly all businesses

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: He says transportation maintenance should be the top priority and funding should first be preceded by an audit of the transportation department.
positions.excerpt: Funding for the Department of Transportation should be addressed by first conducting a comprehensive audit of the organization.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: On wildfire, Hege says the state needs to deal with fuels in forested lands.
positions.excerpt: We need to deal with the fuels that are overtaking our forested lands.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: He says Oregon's tax and regulatory structure adds to the cost of doing business.
positions.excerpt: Oregon’s overall tax and regulatory structure adds to the cost of doing business

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: The Capital Chronicle reports Hege said he does not support taking local control away from communities on data center investment.
positions.excerpt: I do not support taking local control away from communities who could benefit from the investment;

source.publisher: Portland Tribune (Oregon Capital Chronicle)

positions.statement: Hege says in his pamphlet statement that he will support job creation and responsible growth, including agricultural, manufacturing and recreation industries.
positions.excerpt: As your Representative, I will support our agricultural, manufacturing,and recreation industries, stand up for local businesses, and oppose unnecessary regulations that harm employers and workers.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Hege says in his pamphlet statement that Oregon must improve its public education.
positions.excerpt: We must improve our public education, reduce the cost of living and make things more affordable

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Hege says in his pamphlet statement that Oregon must reduce the cost of living and make things more affordable.
positions.excerpt: reduce the cost of living and make things more affordable, and stop policies that drive businesses and families out of state.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Hege says in his pamphlet statement that he would stand up for local businesses and oppose unnecessary regulations that harm employers and workers.
